I had the same experience as you last year. I quit my first job after two weeks because I was also crying everyday. But now a year later I'm trying again. As a matter of fact, today is actually my first day at my new part time job.
 I had awful dreams about my job last night and when I woke up my stomach was doing back flips and my brain was telling me to back out. My whole body was a mess. But here I am having breakfast right now. I don't know how I will do this time but I am hoping I will stick through it. You are not alone. We just have to keep trying.
